rationale.org-governance: Proposes risk-tiered autonomy, verification roles, policy-as-code, and organizational accountability.
rationale.risk-routing: Allocates low-, medium-, and high-risk work to progressively stricter oversight.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Embeds tests, linters, vulnerability scans, invariants, and policy gates.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Defines checkpoints, mandatory review, developer authority, and critical-decision gates.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Requires architectural notes, retrieval summaries, prompt logs, and interpretable reasoning.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Links versioned prompts, context, configurations, outputs, and audit trails.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Operationalizes ISO-aligned quality, safety, accountability, and compliance controls.
rationale.quality-debt: Synthesizes maintainability drift, duplicated logic, explanatory debt, and comprehension loss.
rationale.automation-bias: Synthesizes developer over-reliance, uncritical acceptance, skill erosion, and shallow comprehension.
rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Synthesizes empirical vulnerabilities, insecure defaults, exposed secrets, and unsafe dependencies.
rationale.lit-review: Narratively synthesizes prior research and industry reports without original evidence.
rationale.framework: Presents a reusable intent-to-artifact pipeline architecture with governance controls.
rationale.design-only: Scenarios are explicitly conceptual; no implemented or evaluated system.
rationale.non-developer: Substantively examines domain experts and citizen developers as software creators.
rationale.agentic: Centers end-to-end, multi-step generation of complete artifacts for high-level review.
rationale.steering: Versioned prompts, RAG context, and refinement materially shape generation.
rationale.risk-security: Security vulnerabilities, unsafe defaults, secrets, and attack exposure receive focal analysis.
rationale.risk-quality: Maintainability, comprehension, reliability, and specification drift receive focal analysis.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Over-reliance, skill erosion, and reduced critical inspection receive focal analysis.
rationale.risk-ip: Licensing, attribution, SBOM, and provenance gaps receive focal analysis.
